001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.QuickShopAPI;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.ShopPermissionAudience;
005import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
006
007import java.util.Locale;
008
009public enum BuiltInShopPermission implements ShopPermissionAudience {
010  PURCHASE("purchase", "purchase"),
011  SHOW_INFORMATION("show_information", "show-information"),
012  PREVIEW_SHOP("preview_shop", "preview-shop"),
013  SEARCH("search", "search"),
014  DELETE("delete", "delete"),
015  RECEIVE_ALERT("alert.receive", "receive-alert"),
016  ACCESS_INVENTORY("access_inventory", "access-inventory"),
017  OWNERSHIP_TRANSFER("ownership_transfer", "ownership-transfer"),
018  MANAGEMENT_PERMISSION("management_permission", "management-permission"),
019  TOGGLE_DISPLAY("toggle_display", "toggle-display"),
020  SET_SHOPTYPE("set_shoptype", "set-shoptype"),
021  SET_SHOP_STATE("set_shop_state", "set-shop-state"),
022  SET_PRICE("set_price", "set-price"),
023  SET_ITEM("set_item", "set-item"),
024  SET_STACK_AMOUNT("set_stack_amount", "set-stack-amount"),
025  SET_CURRENCY("set_currency", "set-currency"),
026  SET_NAME("set_name", "set-name"),
027  SET_BENEFIT("set_benefit", "set-benefit"),
028  SET_SIGN_TYPE("set_sign_type", "set-sign-type"),
029  VIEW_PURCHASE_LOGS("view_purchase_logs", "view-purchase-logs");
030
031  private final String node;
032
033  private final String descriptionKey;
034
035  BuiltInShopPermission(@NotNull final String node, @NotNull final String descriptionKey) {
036
037    this.node = node;
038    this.descriptionKey = descriptionKey;
039  }
040
041  @NotNull
042  public String getDescriptionKey() {
043
044    return descriptionKey;
045  }
046
047  @Override
048  public @NotNull String getName() {
049
050    return this.descriptionKey;
051  }
052
053  @Override
054  public boolean hasPermission(@NotNull final BuiltInShopPermission permission) {
055
056    return this == permission;
057  }
058
059  @Override
060  public boolean hasPermission(@NotNull final String permission) {
061
062    return this.node.equals(permission);
063  }
064
065  @NotNull
066  public String getNamespacedNode() {
067
068    return QuickShopAPI.getPluginInstance().getName().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT) + "." + this.node;
069  }
070
071  @NotNull
072  public String getRawNode() {
073
074    return node;
075  }
076}
